layer: application service and domain subsystem with in-memory adapters
purpose: Provide a self-contained commerce operations subsystem for checkout, order management, and customer interactions, exposing a package-level surface for core domain models and an OrderService orchestrator with a CLI demo.
role: subsystem; checkout and order management orchestration with domain models and in-memory adapters
repository_role: Demo commerce operations subsystem offering domain models, service orchestration, pricing, payments, catalog, repository, and notifications with a CLI example.
subsystem_groups: Public surface: __init__.py re-exports CartItem, Customer, Order, Product, OrderService
Application service: services.py OrderService orchestrates checkout, cancellation, and history
Domain models: models.py core entities and validation (Product, Customer, Order, CartItem)
Catalog and SKU utilities: catalog.py product index, reservation/release, normalize_sku
Pricing policy and quotes: pricing.py PricingPolicy and PriceQuote
Payments gateway and types: payments.py PaymentGateway, PaymentReceipt, PaymentError
Notifications and currency formatting: notifications.py NotificationService, format_currency
CLI demo and wiring: cli.py build_demo_service, parse_cart, run_checkout_demo, main
package_mechanism: OrderService coordinates checkout, cancellation, and history by invoking ProductCatalog for inventory, PricingPolicy for quotes, PaymentGateway for authorization/refunds, OrderRepository for persistence, and NotificationService for receipts and alerts. Domain models encapsulate validation and state transitions. __init__.py defines the package-level surface via re-exports. cli.py wires demo components and executes a sample flow.
dependency_direction: No incoming package edges observed. Internal flow: CLI -> OrderService; OrderService -> {catalog, pricing, payments, repository, notifications}; these depend on domain models. Outgoing edges target Python standard library utilities (dataclasses, datetime, typing, uuid).
inputs: Customer instances for checkout and history
Raw cart item strings 'sku:qty' via CLI parse_cart
PricingPolicy configuration: tax_rate_bps and coupons mapping
Order identifiers for repository operations and cancellation
outputs: Persisted and updated Order entities via OrderRepository
Composed receipt and low-stock alert messages recorded by NotificationService
Reserved/released inventory state in Product entities
key_workflows: Checkout: reserve items in ProductCatalog, compute quote via PricingPolicy.quote, authorize payment via PaymentGateway.authorize, mark order paid and persist via OrderRepository.save, send receipt and possible low-stock alerts via NotificationService; release reserved items on failure.
Cancel order: retrieve order from OrderRepository.get, release reserved items via ProductCatalog.release_items, mark order cancelled, then save.
Customer history: list orders for a customer via OrderRepository.list_by_customer (used by OrderService.customer_history).

CLI demo: build_demo_service to assemble ProductCatalog, PricingPolicy, PaymentGateway, OrderRepository, NotificationService, and OrderService; parse raw items and run a sample checkout and summary print.
side_effects: Inventory reservation and release via Product.reserve and Product.release
Customer balance debit/credit via Customer.debit and Customer.credit
In-memory order persistence mutations in OrderRepository
PaymentGateway counters for authorized and refunded totals
Order state transitions and event log appends
errors: ValueError from domain validations: Product.reserve/release, Customer.debit/credit, Order.mark_paid/mark_cancelled, CartItem.validate
PaymentError for invalid amounts or wrapped Customer.debit/credit failures in PaymentGateway operations
KeyError on missing entries in ProductCatalog.get and OrderRepository.get
ValueError and AttributeError from PricingPolicy initialization and quote helpers (coupon normalization, subtotal, tax calculation)
Exceptions from NotificationService formatting and attribute access when customer/order/product data is missing
CLI parse_cart errors converting qty or splitting 'sku:qty' strings; propagation of constructor errors during demo wiring
Propagation of exceptions across OrderService orchestration; compensating releases on checkout failure
architectural_assumptions: In-memory adapters (catalog, repository, notifications) with no external datastore
Synchronous orchestration within a single process
Package-level public surface is defined by __init__.py re-exports
OrderService expects collaborators implementing the methods used in checkout, cancellation, and history
Currency handled in integer cents; coupons normalized to uppercase
SKU normalization is uppercase after trimming
No external I/O beyond stdout in CLI; no network or persistence integrations in evidence
files: __init__.py: Define the package-level public surface for commerce_ops by re-exporting core domain models and the order service from submodules.

catalog.py: Provide a product catalog module that maintains a normalized-SKU index for Product lookups and exposes catalog operations for listing available products and coordinating reservation/release of quantities. Also exposes a utility to normalize SKU strings.
cli.py: Provide a small CLI/demo module that constructs a demo OrderService, parses 'sku:qty' cart items, performs a sample checkout, and prints a summary.

models.py: Provide dataclass-backed domain models for commerce operations: Product inventory control, Customer balance management, Order status transitions with event logging, and CartItem validation. Expose validated, stateful operations used by catalog, payments, repository, services, and CLI layers.
notifications.py: Provide a notification service that composes and records order-related messages (receipts and low-stock alerts) and a helper to format currency amounts used in receipts.

payments.py: Provide a payment service API (PaymentGateway) with authorization and refund operations, a structured receipt type (PaymentReceipt), and a domain-specific error (PaymentError) for payment failures.
pricing.py: Provide a pricing policy service that computes shopping cart price quotes and a simple PriceQuote data object for returning computed totals.

repository.py: Provide an in-memory repository for Order entities used by service-layer operations, supporting save, retrieval, customer-scoped listing, and a mark-paid workflow that coordinates with the Order domain model.

services.py: Expose an application-level service that coordinates checkout, order cancellation, and customer order history by orchestrating catalog, pricing, payments, order persistence, and customer notifications.
summary: Provide a self-contained commerce operations subsystem for checkout, order management, and customer interactions, exposing a package-level surface for core domain models and an OrderService orchestrator with a CLI demo.
